metadata.description: Dominik Woźniak's software delivery process for Claude Code: a plugin marketplace and the code behind it.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Dominik Woźniak's software delivery process in one plugin: deterministic guards that refuse destructive git, the env files the repository does not vouch for, the wrong package manager, sloppy commits and writes to App Store Connect; the Sync that brings a repository's References to their ref as a session starts; and the skills /sdlc-setup, /sdlc-doctor and /sdlc-references-add. A repository's own rules come from its .ai/agentic.config.json.
